	<ResortReportHeadline>Weather Incoming!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>We have some weather coming folks.&nbsp; Some high cloud has moved in, and the wind has picked up to a stiff northerly, which is meant to increase significantly as the day progresses.&nbsp; There is no precipitation at the moment, but there is a big blob moving our way on the radar. The current temp is minus 1, so hopefully the initial precip falls as snow and then we'll see what happens later on when the day warms.&nbsp;&nbsp;Regardless, the temperature is forecast to plummet overnight, and heavy snow is predicted during the early hours, so we should wake to a much whiter mountain tomorrow morning.</p><p>The snow has had a decent freeze overnight, so will start the day off firm before softening with precip of any type. Get out there for the early turns.... or brave the elements when things get real later on.&nbsp; Road Runner is scheduled for 7:30am First Tracks.&nbsp; &nbsp;</p><p>Cheers Bill</p></ResortReport>
